author: Lisa Levin
title: 66 Biggest Movers From Yesterday
text:
Gainers Nortech Systems Incorporated (NASDAQ: NSYS ) shares rose 93.29 percent to close at $6.34 on Wednesday. Container Store Group Inc (NYSE: TCS ) shares surged 44.49 percent to close at $9.58 on Wednesday after reporting comp store sales were up 4.7 percent in the first quarter. Adjusted EPS came in at $(0.08), up from $(0.11) in the same quarter of last year. The company raised its FY2018 outlook.
